metadata.timing_median_policy: at least three unique timing_valid repetitions; every excluded/partial raw row is retained
metadata.process_isolation: owned sessions and PID/create_time identities; measured shutdown sends SIGTERM only to the original leader; cleanup verifies all captured original identities exited
metadata.client_wall_limit: one absolute15s deadline through readiness connect/send/headers/body (bodycapture expected length+1, wirecapture16KiB+expected length+1); hold-entry marker15s; official SIGTERM exit5s; failed phase cleanup bounded owned TERM/KILL

host_contention_policy.excluded: runner ancestors and runner/server/client descendant PIDs
host_contention_policy.sampling_cadence: variable: readiness/hold-entry polls10ms, exit waits50ms, plus request and process-scan duration; monitor skips intervals below50ms
host_contention_policy.consecutive_threshold_interpretation: two busy observed intervals span at least approximately100ms plus scan/request delay, rather than the sustained-load runner's nominal500ms

metadata.load_model: one completed lifespan-state request per server process; active phase additionally holds one request until shutdown cancellation
metadata.latency_limitations: lifecycle observations are affected by same-process request handling and observer sampling; no sustained throughput or per-request CPU equivalence is claimed
metadata.resource_boundary: two independent server process lifetimes per row: idle and active; startup/readiness/held request/shutdown included, with in-process observer CPU reported separately
metadata.memory_limitations: sampled process-tree RSS peak; not allocator peak or proportional/private set size
metadata.correctness_gate: exact lifespan-state response, held request entry before SIGTERM, held cancellation before lifespan shutdown completion, expected exit and strict diagnostics validated
metadata.observer_memory_limitations: observer_process_tree_rss_peak_mib includes the in-process requester and its server descendants; server_rss_peak_mib remains the server-only sampled tree

cancellation_diagnostic_normalization.rust_optional_suffix: one trailing space from PyErr's empty-message display
cancellation_diagnostic_normalization.uvicorn_log_level: publicERROR without colors; unexpected logger errors remain visible
cancellation_diagnostic_normalization.uvicorn_timeout_line: ERROR:    Cancel 1 running task(s), timeout graceful shutdown exceeded
cancellation_diagnostic_normalization.uvicorn_terminal_exception: asyncio.exceptions.CancelledError: Task cancelled, timeout graceful shutdown exceeded
cancellation_diagnostic_normalization.uvicorn_traceback_frames: exact installed protocol run_asgi, proxy_headers.__call__, lifespan_asgi.app Event.wait, stdlib asyncio.locks.Event.wait; file/function/source text and observed line verified, optional caret display only
cancellation_diagnostic_normalization.requirements: exact held-entry/cancellation/lifespan markers in order, expected official exit, no other error, traceback, exception chain, task diagnostic, or panic; per-phase normalization receipt and full raw logs retained
cancellation_diagnostic_normalization.uvicorn_exit_normalization: 0 or -SIGTERM only after the same ASGI completion checks; Uvicorn intentionally re-raises the captured SIGTERM

metadata.observer_startup_limitations: shared observer initializes after server spawn and before the first readiness request; its reported CPU and elapsed work can affect cold-start observations

definitions.cold_start_to_first_lifespan_request_ms: phase preparation (free port, environment, process spawn) through observed valid lifespan-state response; polling/observer/request delays make this an upper bound on application readiness, with no sub-poll startup precision claim
definitions.idle_sigterm_to_process_exit_ms: SIGTERM to process exit after one completed request
definitions.active_sigterm_to_process_exit_ms: SIGTERM to process exit while an ASGI request is blocked; cancellation marker required

server_shutdown.cleanup_verification: original root reaped; tracked original descendant identities exited or are zombies; recycled PIDs ignored

idle.observer_limitations: same-host observer consumes CPU; its measured CPU is reported and excluded from unrelated-process contention
idle.server_cpu_limitations: reaped-child lifetime CPU includes startup/readiness/shutdown; no other child is created or reaped in this phase
